chapter.verse: Pasian’ deihna hangin Khazih Zeisu’ sawltak ahi keimah Paul in Efesa khua-ah a om misiangthote leh Khazih Zeisu sunga midikte kiangah thu kong zasak hi.
I Pa Pasian leh Topa Zeisu Khazih kiang pan hehpihna thupha leh nopna note tungah om ta hen.

Eite in Pasian mai-ah itna sungah siangthoin, mawhna tawh kikhen nadingin leitung pian’ma-in eite Khazih sungah hong teel mah bangin, vantung tawh kipawl omna-ah thuphate khempeuh tawh Khazih hanga eite hong hehpih i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ Pa Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Tua Pasian in a it a Tapa hanga eite hong hehpihna vangliatna a phate phat dinginah
Zeisu Khazih hangin ama tapa-za i ngah nadingin hong deih hong hehpihna hangin, amahmah adingin amasa-ah hong koih khol hi.
Pilna khempeuh leh phawktheih pilna khempeuh tawh kituak, eite tungah hehpihna a kicin’sak mah bangin tua Zeisu’ sisan hangin mawh maisakna ahi tatkhiatna thupha ama sungah eite in i ngah hi.
Pasian in a ngimsa bangin hih a, Khazih hanga a sepsawm a sehsa thuthuk eite hong thei sak hi.
A hun a kicin’ cianga a sep ding Pasian’ geelna in vantung leh leitungah a om na khempeuh gawmin Khazih uk sak ding ahi hi.
Ama deihna tawh kipawl hanciamna bangin tanglai peka eite hong ciamtehsa bangin eite in tua Khazih sungah luahna na i hi hi.
Tua bang ahihna in Khazih hanga a muang zo eite in a vangliatna phat dingte i suah na’ng hi.
Note in zong note hong gupna thu tawh kipawl Lungdamna Thu ahi thuman thutak ngai-in, tua Khazih na up khit uh ciangin thuciamna tawh kipawl Kha Siangtho-a ciamtehna na ngah zo uh hi.
Pasian’ neihsa leh Pasian’ vangliatna a phat nading deihna-in tua Kha Siangtho in tatkhiatna hun dong eite luahna maleep ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in Topa Zeisu upna leh misiangtho khempeuhte na itna uh thu ka theih khit ciangin,
note paulamin hehpihna ka phat niloh a, note ading thungenin ka om hi.
Ka thungetna in: eite Topa Zeisu Khazih’ Pasian, vangliatna Pa in amah theihtel nadingin pilna ahi zongin, theih baihna lungsim ahi zongin hong piak nadingin,
hong sapna tawh kipawl lametna in bang ci bang lametna hi ahi zongin, misiangthote’ neih Topa luahna vangliatna bangzaha lian ahi zongin,
eite tungah hong bawlpha a lian mahmah vangliatna bangzaha lian ahi zongin note in na theih nadingun, na pilna mittang uh a vak nadingin thu ka ngen hi.
Tua vangliatna in Khazih sihna pan a thawh sak kik ciangin Khazih tungah a bawl vangliatna ahi hi.

Na khempeuh a sang belna, ukna, vangliatna leh aana-a kipan tu laitak leitung bek hi lo, nung ciangin a piang ding leitungah a kisam a kiphuak min khempeuh tung, vantungah ama ziat lam a sang mahmah omna-ah a tu sak hi.
Pasian in Khazih’ khe nuai-ah na khempeuh khiasukin, na khempeuh tungah a uk lutang suak sakin pawlpi adingin a pia hi.
Tua pawlpi in na khempeuh, na khempeuh tawh a kicing sakpa’ kicin’na a hi Khazih’ pumpi ahi hi.
